name: @mihaldmo/deepseek-code
description: Terminal-native AI coding agent powered by DeepSeek

scripts.build: rm -rf ./dist && bun build src/index.tsx --outdir ./dist --target bun --external ai-sdk-cpp && printf '#!/usr/bin/env bun\n' | cat - ./dist/index.js > ./dist/tmp && mv ./dist/tmp ./dist/index.js && chmod +x ./dist/index.js && cp -R ./src/skills/bundled ./dist/bundled && cp -R ./src/workflows/bundled ./dist/workflows && cp ./CHANGELOG.md ./dist/CHANGELOG.md
